description: Click an element by its visible text content. Works on React dropdowns, portals, and overlays that may not appear in snapshots. CSP-safe (no eval). Prefers deepest matching element.

exact.description: Require exact match instead of substring (default false)

index.description: Which match to click if multiple (0-based, default 0)

text.description: Text to match against element content (first line)

name: browser_click_text
